note: Private RV park on a working farm (cattle pens and grain bins beside the sites) on County Rd 8 at the I-80 Big Springs interchange, next to a Maverik. Hosts let you choose your site; storm shelter on site. CAMPER-REPORTED RATE: $40 a night in October 2026 (RV Life review); the park has no web page of its own, only a 'Coming Soon' placeholder (2026-11-05). --Claude
summary: Operator site is now a GoDaddy 'Coming Soon' placeholder, so priced from dated camper reports: $40 (10/2026, 8/2026). Fees added (reported). Gate passes: Google 4.6/181, RV Life 8.44/127, phone 308-889-5093, $40 under $50. Working farm selling nights to I-80 overnighters. Not waterfront confirmed; pin OK.
flags: PRIVATE GATE passes: rate $40 camper-reported (RV Life 10/2026 and 8/2026 x2; $43 8/2026) - the operator has no page of its own, so the camper route applies; presence = Google 181 reviews + phone 308-889-5093 (Google and RV Life); Google 4.6 from 181; RV Life 8.44/10 from 127; not a Good Sam park; no gateway within 40 km (Denver 287 km) but $40 passes anyway.

WEBSITE: https://mcgreercamp.com/ is a GoDaddy 'Coming Soon' placeholder with no content (a blank shell is not the operator's page). Google and RV Life still link it. Drop it, or keep it only if AWH wants the placeholder.

WORKING FARM: reviews 8/2026 'The park is a working farm and everyone is so busy but the full hookup sites are level and spacious' and 'Most will say something about it being a farm ... convenient for an overnight stop'; imagery shows feedlot pens and grain bins immediately south and east of the RV loop. It sells nights to transients: all five newest reviews are overnight stops. Long-stay tests pass on what I read (no monthly rate posted, no resident complaints in the reviews read).

UNVERIFIED: the stored 28-site count, 30/50 A, max_rig_ft 40, showers, laundry, dump and year-round came from the operator site before it went to a placeholder; nothing readable now confirms them except reviews mentioning full hookups and pull-throughs. Left as stored.
WATERFRONT not waterfront confirmed: farmland and the interchange only, no water in the frame.
